title: Remove the deprecated ia compile command in 3.0
summary: Breaking: the deprecated ia compile command is removed in 3.0, including its --help and legacy-option forms. Every invocation exits 2 with IA-CLI-USAGE and directs callers to ia capture --help before opening a workspace or evaluating mandates. Replace ia compile with ia capture, retaining --preview, --json, --root and --actor where needed; omit --force because capture always writes. The old --out and --stdout options have no equivalent because capture writes .ia/work/snapshot/current.json and its previous snapshot, not the 1.x ia.compiled.v1 artifact. The token remains reserved against extension takeover. Published @inventarch/cli/internal/compile helper exports and signatures are retained for programmatic callers.
